Name: Publius
Summary: Publius was the chief man of Malta who courteously lodged Paul's shipwrecked company for three days, and whose father Paul healed of fever and dysentery, after which others on the island came and were healed.
KeyStory: Publius lodged the shipwrecked company three days, and his father's healing opened the island to Paul.
LifeLesson: Hospitality to strangers became healing for an island. Publius lodged Paul and found his father whole.
